title: Instance Awareness of Multi-class Semantic Segmentation Loss Functions
mechanism: One-vs-rest extension of blob / CC losses so each class and each instance contributes equally, with inverse-size weighting confined inside each component.
adaptation: Apply the multi-class CC loss over crack, inactive, splice, gridline, edge_dark, material so the rare and weak classes get equal signal on 478 cells.
min_experiment: Arm house + multi-class CC loss vs SUP100, 5 v 5. Metric mIoU_rob, inactive IoU, crack IoU. Kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01 and inactive < +0.03, or crack IoU < -0.012.
evidence: R: BraTS-METS 2025, 260 test cases: foreground Dice 0.64 vs 0.59 baseline; inverse-size weighting raises rare-class Dice to 0.44 at a detection cost.

alt_notes.adaptation: Apply jointly to rare and weak classes (crack, inactive, splice, gridline, edge_dark, material) so each instance gets equal signal.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house loss + multi-class CC loss, 5 seeds; baseline SUP100. Metric mIoU_rob, inactive IoU, crack IoU. Kill: mIoU_rob < +0.01 and inactive IoU < +0.03, crack not worse than -0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Apply to small-component defect classes (crack, inactive, gridline, splice, edge_dark, material) only; structural classes keep CE.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + multi-class CC loss over 6 defect classes, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: mIoU_rob, gridline and splice IoU, crack IoU. Kill: mIoU_rob < house + 0.005 or crack IoU drop > 0.012.
